title.zh: 从依据到应用：四章演练
title.en: From evidence to application: four chapters

brief.zh: 先阅读本节知识卡并说明依据，再完成应用检查。整章学习交付后再进入正式练习；以下条件仅限本演练。
brief.en: Read the knowledge card and explain the evidence before applying it. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter. Conditions below apply only to this exercise.

prompt.zh: 把本演练的两项工作送到合适的方案窗口。
prompt.en: Route the two exercise tasks to their appropriate solution.

reason.zh: 若按是否用了AI来分会误判。请回看“规则与学习”：固定条件决定动作，数据学习用于预测；再检查两个任务的依据。
reason.en: Classifying by whether AI is used is misleading. Revisit Rules and learning: fixed conditions determine actions, while prediction learns from data. Check the basis for each task.

prompt.zh: 同事说需求预测也该照抄固定报销规则。根据本演练，选择反驳依据。
prompt.en: A colleague would copy fixed expense rules for demand forecasting. Select the evidence against this in the exercise.

reason.zh: 需求预测在本例中从数据学习模式；固定审批依照明确条件。若选反了，回看知识卡的两种决策依据。
reason.en: Demand forecasting learns patterns from data in this case; fixed approval follows explicit conditions. If reversed, revisit the two decision bases in the card.

text.zh: 预测需要从数据学习模式
预测只需照搬固定审批条件
text.en: Prediction only copies fixed approval conditions

questions.q: 同事把本演练的固定审批和需求预测都交给固定规则，哪项应重新分流？
questions.a: 需求预测：从数据学习模式

en.q: Both exercise tasks were routed to fixed rules. Which needs rerouting?
en.a: Demand forecasting: learn patterns from data

questions.quote: 规则把明确条件映射为动作；机器学习从数据学习模式。本演练中，固定报销审批使用规则，需求预测使用机器学习。

brief.zh: 先阅读本节知识卡并说明依据，再完成应用检查。整章学习交付后再进入正式练习；以下条件仅限本演练。
brief.en: Read the knowledge card and explain the evidence before applying it. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter. Conditions below apply only to this exercise.

prompt.zh: 仅按本演练同一期间数据：部署40、运行60、已兑现收益150。填写完整成本、净收益与简单ROI百分数（填50代表50%）。
prompt.en: Use only this exercise, same period: deployment 40, operations 60, realized benefits 150. Enter full cost, net benefit and simple ROI percentage (50 means 50%).

reason.zh: 若只填部署40，漏了运行60。完整成本40+60=100；净收益150−100=50；ROI=50/100×100%=50%。150%把总收益当成净收益。回看“完整成本与ROI”。
reason.en: Entering deployment cost 40 omits operations 60. Full cost=40+60=100; net benefit=150−100=50; ROI=50/100×100%=50%. 150% confuses gross benefits with net benefits. Revisit Full cost and ROI.

questions.q: 同事算出本演练ROI为150%，应如何纠正？
questions.a: 先扣除完整成本100，再用净收益50除以100

en.q: A colleague reports exercise ROI as 150%. What corrects it?
en.a: Subtract full cost 100, then divide net benefit 50 by 100

questions.quote: 本演练在同一期间的部署成本为40，运行成本为60，已兑现收益为150。完整成本100，净收益50，简单ROI为50%。

brief.zh: 先阅读本节知识卡并说明依据，再完成应用检查。整章学习交付后再进入正式练习；以下条件仅限本演练。
brief.en: Read the knowledge card and explain the evidence before applying it. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter. Conditions below apply only to this exercise.

prompt.zh: 本演练：客服需读取政策，运维需读取日志。只勾选完成工作所必需的读取权限，未勾选表示不授予。
prompt.en: Exercise: support needs policies and operations needs logs. Select only required read permissions; unchecked means not granted.

reason.zh: 漏选会阻碍工作，多选会越权。应且仅应选客服:政策、运维:日志；使用AI不增加访问需求。回看“最小权限”并逐格核对角色任务。
reason.en: Missing cells prevent work; extra cells overgrant access. Select exactly support:policies and operations:logs. AI adds no access need. Revisit Least privilege and compare each cell with the role task.

questions.q: 本演练给客服开放了政策和日志读取，如何修复？
questions.a: 保留政策读取，撤销日志读取
wrong: 为方便使用AI而保留全部权限

en.q: Support can read policies and logs in this exercise. How should access be repaired?
en.a: Keep policy read access and revoke log read access
wrong: Keep all access for AI convenience

questions.quote: 本演练中，客服只需要读取政策，运维只需要读取日志。不能因为使用AI就让所有角色访问所有资料。

brief.zh: 先阅读本节知识卡并说明依据，再完成应用检查。整章学习交付后再进入正式练习；以下条件仅限本演练。
brief.en: Read the knowledge card and explain the evidence before applying it. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter. Conditions below apply only to this exercise.

prompt.zh: 按本案例给定流程重排操作卡；这是本演练条件，不是所有项目的通用生命周期。
prompt.en: Reorder the operation cards using this case sequence. This is an exercise condition, not a universal project lifecycle.

reason.zh: 先记录基线，再比较测试结果，最后受控上线；提前上线跳过比较依据。回看“受控上线”的原文顺序后重排。
reason.en: Record a baseline, compare test results, then release under controls. Releasing early skips comparison evidence. Revisit the source sequence in Controlled release before retrying.

prompt.zh: 本案例已经记录基线，但还没比较测试结果。下一步选什么？
prompt.en: In this case a baseline is recorded but test results are not compared. What comes next?

reason.zh: 先记录基线，再比较测试结果，最后受控上线；提前上线跳过比较依据。回看“受控上线”的原文顺序后重排。
reason.en: Record a baseline, compare test results, then release under controls. Releasing early skips comparison evidence. Revisit the source sequence in Controlled release before retrying.

questions.q: 本案例已有基线，尚未比较测试结果，同事准备上线，应该先做什么？

en.q: A baseline exists, but tests have not been compared and a colleague plans release. What comes first?

questions.quote: 本演练给定的步骤是先记录基线，再比较测试结果，最后受控上线。这是本案例的演练顺序，不宣称所有项目只有这一种流程。
